definition: a superior, excellent crown.
example_en: The excellent crown shone upon the king's head.

definition: the state or quality of including being included in.
example_en: The committee took the decision with everyone's inclusion.

definition: that which is breakable.
example: ಈ ಗಾಜಿನ ಪಾತ್ರೆ ಭಂಜಕವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಇಡು.
example_en: Keep this glass vessel carefully, for it is breakable.

definition: a flowering plant.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿಯ ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಪೂಗಿಡ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: The flowering plant in front of grandmother's house has grown well.

definition: a rubbing, esp. of one object against another; friction.
example_en: A spark was struck by the friction of the two stones.

definition: a being together so closely and thickly as to hinder mutual growth.
example_en: Because of the plants growing too closely together, their growth was stunted.

definition: that which is got, obtained.
example_en: The attainment gained from that endeavour was very great.

definition: on the other hand; in contrast; but.
example_en: I will come, but it may be a little late.

definition: to praise; to laud.
example_en: The disciples praised the guru's knowledge.

definition: the string of a bow.
example_en: He loosened the bowstring.

definition: any of various harmful insects, worms, etc.
example_en: Harmful pests attacked the crop and caused damage.

definition: energetic activity; ferment.
example_en: On the fair day, there was a lot of energetic activity in the village.

definition: a person who is not straightforward; a dishonest, crooked man; a crook.
example_en: That crooked trader cheated the customers.

definition: an apparatus for regulating temperature, esp. one that automatically controls a heating or cooling unit; a thermostat.
example_en: The thermostat keeps the room temperature steady.

definition: a scissor-like contrivance for cutting the areca nut.
example_en: Grandmother cut the areca nut with the areca-nut cutter.

definition: to exert pressure so as to move forward; to push forward.
example_en: He pushed the cart forward.

definition: a pot of metal or earth.
example_en: She filled the pot with water.

definition: a professional actor.
example_en: That professional actor was famous in the theatre.

definition: that which is related to the thigh.
example_en: The doctor explained about the muscles related to the thigh.

definition: the quality or state of causing fear, awe; dreadfulness.
example_en: People fled from the demon's dreadfulness.

definition: to blend, unite or bond (together) as one whole; to fuse together.
example_en: They heated the two metals in fire and fused them together.

definition: a seasoning of food with oil, spices, asafoetida, etc.
example_en: If you do not add seasoning to the tamarind dish, the taste will not be enough.

definition: (in a musical concert) to allow accompanying instrumentalists (esp. those accompanying on percussion instruments) to play.
example: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಗಾಯಕ ತನಿಬಿಡು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದಾಗ ಮೃದಂಗಗಾರ ತನ್ನ ವಾದ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬಾರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: When the lead singer said to give a solo, the mridangam player played his instrument.

definition: the act of abusing, blaming; abuse; blame.
example_en: It is wrong to abuse the poor.

definition: an interrogative sentence, addressed to someone in order to get information in reply; a question.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಪಾಠದ ಬಳಿಕ ಒಂದು ಪರಸನ ಕೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: After the lesson, the teacher asked a question.

definition: a long duration of time.
example_en: We lived in this house for a long duration of time.

definition: one who pleads the cause of another in a court of law; an advocate; [fr. Eng. advocate].
example: ಆ ಅಡ್ವೊಕೇಟು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಕ್ಷಿದಾರರ ಪರವಾಗಿ ವಾದಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That advocate argued in court on behalf of the client.

definition: the coagulaed part of sour milk.
example_en: The grandmother made cottage cheese at home from the coagulated sour milk.

definition: (rhet.) that which is inconsistent with a particular branch of learning, science, custom, etc.
example_en: That statement was inconsistent with the scripture.

definition: a taking of fruits only for food.
example_en: During chaturmasya, the swami accepts only a fruit meal.

definition: any of the acute, severe diseases.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡಬೇನೆ ಹರಡಿ ಜನರು ಆತಂಕಗೊಂಡರು.
example_en: People were alarmed as an acute disease spread in that village.

definition: till; upto (the point of time or point, place).
example_en: He sat waiting until the evening.

definition: to see from the corner of the eye.
example_en: She smiled, glancing at her beloved from the corner of her eye.

definition: an order, command or instruction.
example_en: The commander gave an order to the soldiers.

definition: in football game, the space between two poles set at the opposite ends of a field through which or a net into which the ball must be passed to score; the goal.
example_en: The player kicked the ball into the goal.

definition: the blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: Colorful flowers had bloomed in the garden.

definition: resolute, determined or courageous mind.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕನ ಕಲಿಮನ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಲುವು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That soldier's courageous mind brought victory in the battle.

definition: to be present in front of.
example_en: The soldier presented himself before the king.

definition: money put in a bank (usu. for certain period of time which earns a fixed rate of interest); a fixed deposit.
example_en: He has put a fixed deposit in the bank.

definition: an enclosed case or recess with shelves to hold clothes, valuables, plates, dishes, food etc. a cupboard.
example_en: Mother arranged the clothes in the cupboard.

definition: the region inhabited by human beings.
example_en: People live peacefully in this region.

definition: keenly eager; desirous; anxious.
example_en: She was keenly eager for the result.

definition: small or short in stature; dwarfish.
example: ಆ ವಾಮನ ಬಾಲಕ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: That dwarfish boy drew everyone's attention.

definition: expertness with the hands; manual skill; handicraft.
example_en: Everyone admired his manual skill.

definition: a literary work that has elaborate and brilliant descriptions.
example_en: That poet's elaborately descriptive literary work amazed readers.

definition: a dried, thin layer forming on the surface (as of blood, pus, ointment, etc. on the skin).
example_en: A dried crust was seen over the wound.

definition: a celestial body revolving around the sun, in a highly eccentric orbit, consisting of a central mass surrounded by an envelope of dust and gas that may form a tail that streams away from the sun; a comet.
example_en: The comet appeared very bright in the sky.

definition: a small box, fixed on poles to carry one sitting in it, on the shoulders of others; a palankeen.
example_en: The servants seated the king in a palanquin and carried him away.

definition: any of crickets of the family of Gryllotalpidae, having large front legs specialised for burrowing, and feeding chiefly on roots; a mole-cricket.
example_en: The mole-cricket was digging a tunnel in the soil.

definition: the snake boa constrictor, a kind of rock snake.
example_en: The boa constrictor coiled tightly around its prey.

definition: watchful attention.
example_en: The guard's watchful attention did not slacken the whole night.

definition: an educating young children; a giving of elementary education.
example_en: Elementary education for children is important for their growth.

definition: boiling water.
example_en: The boiling water was seething noisily in the pot.

definition: to stop from moving; to remain where one is.
example_en: Everyone stopped moving when the teacher arrived.

definition: a good or favourable rain.
example_en: This year the crop is good due to favourable rain.

definition: an inflamed spots or blister on the skin as in the case of leprosy.
example_en: A blister had appeared on his body.

definition: the undomesticated cat Felis chaus, a forest-inhabitant; wild-cat.
example_en: The wildcat hunts at night.

definition: (phil.) the theory that sense experience is the only source of knowledge; empiricism.
example_en: That philosopher propounded the theory of empiricism.

definition: any large, detached rock.
example_en: A large detached rock had fallen on the path.

definition: a small, round water container with a slightly narrow neck, made of metal, usu. copper.
example_en: The water-container in the kitchen was very old.

definition: the salt waters that cover the greater part of the earth's surface; sea; ocean.
example_en: The ship was sailing on the sea.

definition: the back of the neck; the nape.
example_en: She pressed the back of her neck and sat down in pain.

definition: one of the minor, religious scriptures of Hindus.
example_en: The priests recited verses from the Chintyagama scripture.

definition: a fine, mistlike rain; drizzle.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ಸೀರ್ಪನಿವಡಹ ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನು ಆವರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: In the early morning, a fine drizzle enveloped the whole village.

definition: to increase the intensity, degree, extent, etc. of.
example_en: The wind increased the intensity of the flame.

definition: special; extraordinary; excellent.
example: ಅವನ ಸಾಧನೆ ಉರುತರವಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His extraordinary achievement won everyone's admiration.

definition: to hang loosely; to walk or move unsteadily; to waddle.
example_en: That rope was hanging loosely and swaying in the wind.

definition: a honey-bee.
example_en: The honey-bee kept flying from flower to flower.

definition: the red or reddish colour.
example_en: That flower had a reddish colour.

definition: a sticky, colloidal carbohydrate found in certain trees and plants; gum.
example_en: Gum was oozing out from the tree trunk.

definition: to tell a story in speech or writing; to give an account of happenings; to narrate.
example_en: Grandfather narrated the old story to his grandchildren.

definition: to walk; to step.
example_en: The child walked slowly.

definition: to send out, give forth a good odor or fragrance.
example_en: A fragrance was wafting from the kitchen.

definition: any of the citrus fruits; a citrus fruit.
example_en: She bought a sweet citrus fruit.

definition: an electric bulb.
example_en: The electric bulb was spreading light in the room.

definition: indecent words; abusive language.
example_en: He spoke abusive words in anger.

definition: a supporting or being supported; support.
example_en: He got his friends' support during hard times.

definition: a shackle or chain for the feet; a fetter.
example_en: A fetter was put on the prisoner's leg.

definition: (bees) to build (their) hive.
example_en: In spring the bees build their hive in the tree.

definition: a person always prone to diseases.
example_en: That sickly person takes medicine all year round.

definition: the fact or quality of adjusting oneself to a region, environment one lives in.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಊರಿನ ದೇಶಸಾತ್ಮ್ಯ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Adjusting to the new town's environment came easily to him.

definition: a native or inhabitant of Europe; an European.
example_en: That merchant was a European.

definition: divided; separated; split.
example_en: The army was split into three groups.

definition: the earth.
example_en: Crops grow upon the earth.

definition: a portion or division of a garden or farm land.
example_en: There were flowering plants in that plot of the garden.

definition: a heavy tool used for pounding.
example_en: She pounded the clothes with the heavy pounding tool.

definition: a man given as a pledge or taken prisoner as by a terrorist, until certain conditions are met; a hostage.
example_en: The terrorists kept that soldier as a hostage.

definition: a chronic disease, caused by obstruction of the lymphatic vessels often due to infestation by filarial worms, characterised by the enlargement of the legs, and by the hardening and ulceration of the surrounding skin: elephantiasis.
example_en: Elephantiasis can result from mosquito bites.

definition: a land measure equal to twenty squares ( = 2000 sq. ft ?).
example: ಈ ಹೊಲ ಸುಮಾರು ಎರಡು ಪಾಡ್ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This field measures about two pad in area.

definition: a single-reed, clarinet-like wind instrument with a wooden or metal tube, played by means of holes.
example_en: Hearing the sound of the clarinet-like wind instrument, everyone gathered.

definition: to reduce to powder; to pulverise; to grind.
example_en: Grandmother pulverised the rice in the mortar.

definition: a decorated figures made of flowers.
example_en: They had created a beautiful flower design at the wedding hall.

definition: the act or practice of tricking; use of tricks; deception; fraud; trickery.
example_en: The traders were cheated because of his trickery.

definition: the behaviour, act of a stupid person.
example_en: Everyone laughed seeing his foolish behaviour.

definition: the cardinal number between nine and eleven; ten; 10.
example_en: Ten people are waiting in the shop.

definition: a thin flat vertical bone and cartilage in the chest connecting the ribs; the sternum.
example_en: The sternum connects the ribs to one another.

definition: to fasten or close with a latch.
example_en: As soon as it became night, the shopkeeper latched the door.

definition: common salt (sodium chloride) produced from sea water.
example_en: They produce common salt from sea water.

definition: an optical illusion, in which a water-body is seen, caused by the refraction of light in the hot air; a mirage.
example_en: The deer mistook the mirage for water.

definition: the bat, a mouselike nocturnal flying mammal; a flying fox.
example_en: The flying fox hung upside down on the tree.

definition: not yielding, not capable of yielding, fruits.
example_en: This year the mango tree is not yielding fruit.

definition: a young girl who has attained puberty lately.
example_en: That newly pubescent girl was not yet ready for marriage.

definition: an ignoble family.
example_en: Though born in an ignoble family, he rose to a high position.

definition: a man whose behaviour, actions are pious, divine or holy.
example_en: That swami is famous as a man of holy conduct.

definition: a movement which brought about disastrous effects in the social, economic, art or literature field; a misfired renaissance.
example_en: That movement turned out to be a misfired renaissance.

definition: a small ball or cone-shaped missile of lead, metal alloy, etc., to be shot from a firearm; a bullet; a slug.
example_en: The soldier's bag was filled with bullets.

definition: to become resolute, firm in pursuing a purpose.
example_en: He became resolute in achieving his goal.

definition: a single woman.
example_en: That single woman is living independently.

definition: a kind of plant.

definition: (masc.) one who is ex-communicated from his family.
example_en: The villagers kept the man excommunicated from his family at a distance.

definition: (an adjective used only in composition, meaning) hard, harsh, etc.
example_en: Everyone was startled to hear his harsh words.

definition: a natural mixture of earth, rock powder, with gold particles (from which gold is extracted).
example_en: There are a few gold particles in this ore-earth.

definition: the clear, lucid way in using words or sentences a literary work, considered as a merit in rhetoric.
example_en: The teacher's clear, lucid expression in writing was admired by all.

definition: a condiment made of grain or pulse with chillies, salt, which is dried and fried in oil, used as relish.

definition: a variety of sandal wood.
example_en: This variety of sandalwood spreads a fragrance just like sandalwood.

definition: a bad, immoral tendency or inclination of the mind.
example_en: His bad, immoral tendency was known to the whole town.

definition: a hail-stone; a graupel.

definition: that is to be asked, questioned or inquired.
example_en: This matter is one to be inquired about.

definition: fish in gen.
example_en: There were various kinds of fish in the pond.

definition: the point directly overhead in the sky or on the celestial sphere; the zenith.
example_en: At noon, the sun stood at the zenith.

definition: milk - a) a white or yellowish emulsion secreted by the mammary glands of female mammals for suckling their young and usu. consisting of fats, proteins, sugars, vitamins, and minerals suspended in water; b) cow's milk or, sometimes, that of goats, camels, etc., drunk by humans as a food or used to make butter, cheese, casein products, etc.; c) any liquid like this, as the juice of various plants or fruits (e.g., coconut milk) or any of various emulsions.
example_en: Mother boils the milk every morning.

definition: any organised procession, march or display, by a military or police force.

definition: (pl.) three persons.
example_en: Three persons lived together in that house.

definition: the act of turning, twisting oneself.
example_en: The twisting of the tree branches was seen in the wind.

definition: remembrances of one's past life.

example_en: Through remembrances of his past life, the yogi recalled his earlier births.

definition: act of smearing; anointing.
example_en: She smeared ointment on the child's wound.

definition: either of two oval sex glands in the male that are suspended in the scrotum and secrete spermatozoa; the testis; the testicle.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಮುಷ್ಕದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ನಡೆಸಿದರು.

definition: a drama composed in metrical, rhythmical form.

definition: to turn one's face downword (from shame, shyness or modesty).

definition: a sub-sect among fishermen.

example_en: That family belongs to the Koli sub-sect.

definition: a certificate recognising one's eligibility, capability, deservedness or character.
example_en: He received an eligibility certificate from the university.

definition: the state of being under the control of someone else and of having no freedom; servitude; slavery.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನರು ಅಡಿಮೆಯ ಬದುಕು ಬದುಕುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In those days, people lived a life of servitude.

definition: a learned man.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನರು ಆ ನಾಣಿಯ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: The people of the village admired that learned man's wisdom.

definition: a courageous, undaunted man.
example_en: The undaunted hero confronted the enemies.

definition: a bullock cart with a decorated arch like shelter over it.
example_en: They used the decorated bullock cart for the wedding procession.

definition: to be fixed firmly into; to be planted or implanted into.
example_en: The sprout's roots became firmly implanted in the soil.

definition: to make a hiss sound expressing tiredness, grief, etc.
example_en: The tired old man sat down and hissed with exhaustion.

definition: a master; a lord; an employer.
example: ಆ ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ಸಾವಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೊಡನೆ ವಿನಯದಿಂದ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The master of that shop speaks politely with everyone.

definition: anger caused by constant irritation.
example: ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿಯಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಶಿಡಕು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Due to repeated irritation, he had anger from constant provocation.

definition: supreme rule; absolute power or authority; dominion.
example_en: That king had supreme rule over the entire country.

definition: a long leg.
example_en: The player's long leg kicked the ball far away.

definition: the twining plant Pentatropis microphylla of Asclepiadaceae family growing in hedges.
example_en: The twining plant had spread over the hedge.

definition: a fence around a town.
example_en: They have put up a fence around the town.

definition: (breeze) to bring coolness, pleasantness to.
example_en: That breeze brought coolness to the sweaty body.

definition: (fem.) one who swims; a swimmer.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಈಜುಗಾರ್ತಿ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That town's best woman swimmer won the competition.

definition: a boy or man who is studying or learning; a student.
example_en: The student goes to school every day and learns.

definition: the breast milk.
example_en: Breast milk is rich in nutrients for the infant.

definition: a duty levied by the government on the goods exported to another country; export-duty.
example_en: Traders incurred losses due to the increase in export duty.

definition: a small metal box for carrying betel leaves, areca nuts, etc. in.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ತನ್ನ ಸಂಬಳಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೀಳ್ಯದೆಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother kept betel leaves and areca nuts in her small metal box.

definition: the humming sound of bees.
example_en: The humming sound of the bees was heard in the flower garden.

definition: the sun, the lord of the day.
example_en: In the scriptures, the lord of the day is spoken of as the sun.

definition: the plant Tylophora indica ( = Asclepias asthmatica) of Asclepiadaceae family; vomitting swallow.
example_en: They had planted the lepala plant behind the house.

definition: a wedge shaped hand tool of steel with a sharp edge, for cutting or making holes in, metal objects; a chisel.
example_en: The sculptor carved the copper plate with a chisel.

definition: a man having or showing skill in the use of his hands; a dexterous man.
example_en: That blacksmith is a skilled, dexterous craftsman.

definition: wandered aimlessly.
example_en: He wandered the streets aimlessly.

definition: the condition, and privilege of being born as a god.
example_en: Through merit, he attained the state of being born as a god.

definition: a pillow or soft pad for sitting or kneeling on or reclining against; a cushion.
example_en: The priest sat on the cushion and meditated.

definition: a bridge that can be raised or drawn aside mechanically to permit passage of watercraft or prevent access; a draw-bridge.
example_en: The drawbridge was raised so ships could pass.

definition: a signal, hint - a) a sign given by gesture, flashing light, etc. to convey a command, direction, warning, etc.; b) an object or device, as a red flag, flashing light, etc., providing such a sign.
example_en: The watchman showed the signal of the red flag.

definition: to hit or strike repeatedly; to pound; to beat.

example_en: The blacksmith shaped the hot iron by beating it repeatedly.

definition: to defraud; to cheat; to deceive.
example_en: The trader was caught cheating his customers.

definition: the edge of something.

example_en: There was an old tree at the edge of that field.

definition: a new offshoot.
example_en: A new offshoot sprouted on the branch of the plant.

definition: the act or an instance of troubling, vexing; harassment; annoyance.
example_en: The traders were fed up with the officials' harassment.

definition: the tree, Cordia dichotoma ( = C. myxa) of Boraginaceae family; Sebesten.
example_en: The sebesten tree had borne fruit.

definition: a fat, corpulent man; a man having large belly.

example_en: That fat man climbed the stairs with great difficulty.

definition: he who is engaged in manufacturing or selling of oil.
example_en: That oil-seller sells oil every day.

definition: to push forward oneself against the stroke of a weapon.
example_en: He pushed himself forward against the stroke of the arrow.

definition: the humming sound of a bee.
example_en: The humming of bees was heard all over the garden.

definition: a diplomatic representative appointed by one country or government to represent it in another; a diplomat.

example_en: That diplomat arranged an agreement between the two countries.

definition: the tip of a tail.
example_en: The tip of the cat's tail was white in colour.
